from pathlib import Path

rows.sort(reverse=True)

print('---')

print(f'notes with per100w > 0: {len(rows)}')
print(f'notes total: {len(list(root.glob(\"*.md\")))}')
"

```bash
cd /home/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com && python3 -c "
import re, yaml, subprocess
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('content/english/notes')
FM = re.compile(r'^---\s*\n(.*?)\n---', re.DOTALL)
FIELDS = ('description','key_concept','examples','shareable_thought')

def frontmatter_text(text):
    m = FM.match(text)
    if not m: return ''
    meta = yaml.safe_load(m.group(1)) or {}
    parts = []
    for f in FIELDS:
        v = meta.get(f)
        if isinstance(v, list): parts.extend(str(x) for x in v)
        elif isinstance(v, str): parts.append(v)
    return '\n'.join(parts)

body_high, fm_high, both = [], [], []
for f in sorted(root.glob('*.md')):
    text = f.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    # body score
    body = text
    if text.startswith('---'):
        end = text.find('\n---', 3)
        if end != -1: body = text[end+4:]
    r = subprocess.run(['python3','-c', '''
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, \"scripts\")
from slop_score import analyze_text
import json
print(json.dumps(analyze_text(open(0).read())))
'''], input=body, capture_output=True, text=True)
    b = __import__('json').loads(r.stdout)
    fm = analyze_text = None
    import importlib.util
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('slop_score', 'scripts/slop-score.py')
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    fm_r = mod.analyze_text(frontmatter_text(text))
    if b['words'] > 0 and b['total_per100w'] > 2.0:
        body_high.append((b['total_per100w'], b['words'], f.name))
    if fm_r['words'] > 0 and fm_r['total_per100w'] > 2.0:
        fm_high.append((fm_r['total_per100w'], fm_r['words'], f.name))
    if (b['words'] > 0 and b['total_per100w'] > 2.0) or (fm_r['words'] > 0 and fm_r['total_per100w'] > 2.0):
        both.append(f.name)

print('=== Body per100w > 2.0 ===')
for per, w, n in sorted(body_high, reverse=True)[:20]:
    print(f'  {per:5.2f}  words={w:4d}  {n}')
print(f'Total: {len(body_high)}')
print()
print('=== Frontmatter per100w > 2.0 ===')
for per, w, n in sorted(fm_high, reverse=True)[:25]:
    print(f'  {per:5.2f}  words={w:4d}  {n}')
print(f'Total: {len(fm_high)}')
"

```

import re, yaml, importlib.util

FIELDS = ("description", "key_concept", "examples", "shareable_thought")

def fm_text(text):

        v = meta.get(f)
        if isinstance(v, list):
            parts.extend(str(x) for x in v)

            parts.append(v)

        if end != -1:

print(f"Total: {len(fm_high)}")

over = []
for f in sorted(root.glob(&#34;*.md&#34;)):
    text = f.read_text(encoding=&#34;utf-8&#34;)
    prose = mod.scoreable_text(f, text)
    r = mod.analyze_text(prose)
    if r[&#34;words&#34;] &gt; 0 and r[&#34;total_per100w&#34;] &gt; 2.0:
